'''2003 Texas State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Texas (21 June 2003). According to his forum signature (captured April 2005), [[Jacob Taylor]] was the "2003 Texas State Champion".<ref name="pcf-4918-68222">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=68222#68222 SWCCG Nine Years Later: "Downloading"], Jacob Taylor (Armaedes), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 March 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050427101113/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=68244%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 21 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Time:''' 9am<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Fee:''' $5<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Luby's Cafeteria, Bedford, Texas<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Jacob Taylor]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
